newsitem.title: USA: Wickes says 401K behind trading activity.
newsitem.headline: Wickes says 401K behind trading activity.

text.p: Wickes Lumber Co said Wednesday the unusual trading activity in its shares late yesterday was due largely to transactions by the independent administrator of its 401K plan.
The trading "was not due to any news announcements or expected news announcements by the company," Wickes said.

It said its 401K administrator was active as a result of an administrative changeover in the plan. It said it expects the administrator "will be purchasing a significant number of shares for employee accounts in the plan in the near future."
Trading volume in Wickes yesterday was 94,000 shares, compared to a 30-day daily average of about 7,300.
Wickes is a large U.S. supplier of building materials.
